oneLine: Marico raises stake in Plix via a Rs 1,012 crore acquisition.

sources.title: Marico raises stake in Plix to 84.09% with Rs 1,012 crore acquisition

synopsis: Marico has acquired an additional 24.09% stake in Satiya Nutraceuticals Private Limited, the company behind plant-based nutrition and wellness brand Plix, for Rs 1,012.03 crore. Completed on October 5, 2026, the cash transaction increases Marico's aggregate holding to 84.09% on a fully diluted basis. The acquisition is part of a phased plan under definitive agreements to buy shares from the founders and certain other shareholders. An additional 14.09% stake is scheduled to be acquired in July 2027 for a base consideration of up to Rs 592 crore alongside milestone-linked amounts. Satiya Nutraceuticals reported a consolidated turnover of Rs 864.31 crore for FY2025-26. The transaction involves shares held by founders, their relatives, and related entities as a related-party transaction executed on an arm's-length basis.
